title: XCTL from a 10-byte (version 1) COMMAREA to a program expecting 80 bytes: upgrade by EIBCALEN, over-long LENGTH, LENGTH out of range

scenarios.summary: XCTL LENGTH(10): CAXB sees EIBCALEN 10, copies 10 bytes and defaults the rest; the 80-byte area then travels through two pseudo-conversational turns until PF3
XCTL LENGTH(80) naming the 10-byte V1 item: CICS copies 80 bytes starting there, so CAXB takes the caller's neighbouring storage as version-2 fields
XCTL LENGTH(32767): outside 0-32763, LENGERR RESP2 11, control stays in CAXA
